author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/30/2018: SNE, AKAM, RMBS
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.7%
AAPL: -0.5%
IBM: +0.2%
CSCO: +0.2%
GOOG: +0.3%
Technology stocks were higher in pre-market trading Tuesday.
Among the stocks moving on news:
(+) Sony ( SNE ) climbed 6% after reporting above-forecast results for fiscal Q2 while increasing its earnings and sales guidance for fiscal 2019
In other sector news:
(+) Akamai Technologies ( AKAM ) rose more than 10% after it reported late Monday Q3 results that topped Wall Street expectations, and set up a new share buyback plan
(-) Rambus ( RMBS ) fell nearly 10% after it posted better-than-expected Q3 earnings; its board named Luc Seraphin president and chief executive officer
